title: Streamed Text Loader
description: Text that animates in as a model streams it: only the newly received characters reveal, in one of 16 styles (focus, decode, typewriter, skeleton, wipe, terminal and more).

props.name: text
props.description: The text received so far. Append to it as chunks arrive: only the new characters animate. A text that does not start with the previous one replays from the start.

props.name: variant
props.description: The reveal style. `skeleton` shows two shimmering bars while `text` is empty.

props.name: speed
props.description: Playback rate: 2 is twice as fast. Non-positive or non-finite values fall back to 1.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color. Pass "currentColor" to follow the surrounding text (and your theme).

props.name: paused
props.description: Render the text without motion (new text appears at once).

props.name: dir
props.description: Labs addition: text direction. `auto` follows the text, so Latin stays in order in a right-to-left page and wipes reveal in reading order.

a11y: The root is a polite live region (role="status", aria-live="polite"); the received text is its visually hidden content, so screen readers announce new text as it arrives (a Labs addition: upstream relied on aria-label, which live regions do not announce).
The animated layer, built from per-character spans, is aria-hidden, so the text is read as words, not letters.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the text appears without motion, and the skeleton bars stop: a static state.
dir="auto" keeps Latin text in order inside right-to-left pages; right-to-left text wipes and redacts in its reading direction.
docs:
Installed `StreamedTextLoader` (`@/components/ui/streamed-text-loader`), with its styles inside the file (React 19 hoists them into `<head>` once) and `motion` for the reveals.

```tsx
import { StreamedTextLoader } from "@/components/ui/streamed-text-loader";

<StreamedTextLoader text={partialReply} variant="focus" color="currentColor" />
```

Pass the reply received so far as `text` and append to it as chunks stream in: only the new characters animate. `color="currentColor"` follows your theme; `variant="skeleton"` shows placeholder bars while `text` is empty. Motion stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Motion renders each reveal's first frame on the server (fresh characters start transparent), so for server-rendered text pass `paused` until the page hydrates, as the demo does.

Ported from generative-loaders (`TextLoader`) by Kasturi Khanke (MIT); the license notice is at the end of the file.
